title: A Block's Secret Life (B73)
description: Adds very lore heavy structures to the game based on past life of sentient blocks.
body:
Adds a structure found in plains biomes where an immortal sentient grass block was writing a journal about it's life and was rudely interupted my you joining. More blocks comming soon.

Made by me for our first mod contest Theme: A Block's Secret Life. Time: 1 hour
